data.title: Rejection of special-use permit for moving container
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt's public order office (Ordnungsamt) rejected your application of 2 July 2026 for a special-use permit (Sondernutzungserlaubnis) to place a moving container in front of Lindenweg 12. The pavement is only 1.40 m wide.
data.explanation: The city refused your permit because the pavement is too narrow to keep pedestrians safe. You cannot place the container there under this application. You may challenge the decision by going straight to court (a lawsuit, or Klage, at the administrative court); there is no separate objection step first. The app shows the deadline, which runs one month from notification. Filing must be in writing or recorded at the court registry. If you want to challenge it, consider getting legal advice soon, or ask the court registry for help. Otherwise the decision becomes final.

items.title: File court action against the rejection
items.action: If you want to challenge the rejection, file a court action (Klage) with the administrative court (Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt) in writing or have it recorded at the court registry.
items.consequence: After the deadline the rejection becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
